rules.statement: The equitable doctrine relating to penalties and forfeitures does not apply to cases where the Court enforces what is commonly called a pre-payment order. Strict compliance with the terms will be insisted on except where there is absolute impossibility of performance.
rules.supporting_quote: "The equitable doctrine of penalties and forfeitures does not apply to cases where the Court enforces what is commonly called a pre-payment order. Strict compliance with the terms will be insisted on except where there is absolute impossibility of performance."
